title: The Lost Keycard
scene: At 10:05 AM, the office keycard vanished. The server room was locked during a fire drill from 9:50 to 10:30.

suspects.name: Rosa Ash
suspects.testimony: I was at the front desk at 10:05, signing in visitors.
suspects.contradiction: The desk log shows no visitors after 9:48, and the keycard was in Rosa's drawer.

suspects.name: Sam Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at my desk at 10:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The desk camera shows Sam at 10:03 and 10:09.

suspects.name: Tito Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in the lobby at 10:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The lobby camera shows Tito at 10:04.

suspects.name: Uma Reed
suspects.testimony: I was in the meeting room at 10:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The meeting room log shows Uma at 10:02 and 10:12.
